title: Gilligan's Island
meta_description: 30A Luxury Vacations is proud to present Gilligan's Island, a custom home with a carriage house that will accommodate the whole family or a large group for the beach vacation you've been waiting for! This home is extremely spacious with tons of amenities.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love- Large Private Heated Pool (28 ft x 20 ft, 7 ft deep-end) (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)- 6 Complimentary Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes- 2 Complimentary Beach Chair Sets (4 Chairs, 2 Umbrellas / March - October Only)- 2 Separate Fully-Equipped Residences- Fully Fenced Yard- Green Space with Cornhole, perfect for Bocce Ball- Game Room on 3rd Floor with Xbox and PS4 on separate TVs, Classic Arcade, Air Hockey- Sonos Sound System, Apple TV, Harmony Elite Remote- Natural Gas GrillFar from simply an ordinary vacation rental home, Gilligan’s Island is a veritable estate! With a main home and guest home totalling 10 bedrooms and 10 bath and accommodating up to 28, this compound is a perfect size for an extended family reunion, or several families travelling together.The nearly modest exterior offers just the slightest hint of the amazing expanse of home and privacy fenced yard that awaits you! From the four levels of covered and furnished patios and decks on the main home to the built-in private pool, there are surprises at every turn at Gilligan’s Island. The green space beyond makes for the perfect corn-hole court, with the game already in place for guests.The interior evokes the feeling of a New England summer, with classic whitewashed walls and colorful pops of ocean blue throughout. The large great room houses an intimate living space with large HDTV and dining space for the whole family with seating at two tables for up to 20, and an additional 4 at the kitchen island. A separate den/game room sits on the top level, with large sofas, two HDTVs, an air hockey table and additional game table, with a wet bar. Step outside and up the spiral staircase to take in the forever Gulf view from the 4th story viewing area with bench seat and 4 seat high top table.The kitchen is equipped for a crowd, with dual stainless steel refrigerators and dishwashers. Other features here include a professional oven and large pantry.From the second floor up to the top, you’ll enjoy spectacular views of the Gulf sparkling just yards away.The guest carriage house is a second fully-contained residence with living room and dining seating for 4, a galley style kitchen with full appliances in stainless steel and 2 ensuite bedrooms, one queen and 1 with a bunk set.MAIN HOME FIRST FLOOR- Open Concept Living and Dining Space- Kitchen with Dual Refrigerators and Dishwashers- GUEST BEDROOM SUITE with king bed. Ensuite bath with oversized walk-in shower.MAIN HOME SECOND FLOOR- MASTER BEDROOM SUITE with king bed, desk and chair, flat screen TV, private deck access. Ensuite bath with dual vanities and oversized walk-in shower. - GUEST BEDROOM FAMILY SUITE with king bed and built-in bunk set (2 Twins), private deck access, flat-screen TV. Ensuite bath with tub/shower. - GUEST BEDROOM FAMILY SUITE with king bed and built-in bunk set (2 Twins), flat screen TV. Ensuite bath with walk-in shower. - GUEST BEDROOM SUITE with king bed, dual nightstands and lamps, and dresser. Ensuite bath with walk-in shower- Full-width covered and furnished deck with Gulf views- Full Washer / DryerMAIN HOME THIRD FLOOR- Game room with two sofas, two flat-screen TVs, air hockey table, game table, wet bar with wine cooler. - GUEST BEDROOM SUITE with king bed, flat screen TV, dual nightstands and lamps, and dresser. Ensuite bath with oversized walk-in shower- BUNK BED BEDROOM with two sets of built-in bunk beds. 2 Queen, 2 Twin. Ensuite bath with oversized walk-in shower.- BUNK BED BEDROOM with two sets of built-in bunk beds. 4 Queen. TV for each bed. Ensuite bath with oversized walk-in shower.GUEST CARRIAGE HOUSE FIRST FLOOR- Great room with living and dining seating for 4- Fully equipped galley-style kitchenGUEST CARRIAGE HOUSE SECOND FLOOR- MASTER BEDROOM SUITE with queen bed. Shared bath with oversized walk-in shower. - BUNK ROOM BEDROOM with Queen bunk set.
